fields.description: Equiterra is a separate neighbourhood within Grand Polo Club & Resort, with three and four bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom residences. Its launch collection comprises 547 homes. Townhouse Styles B and C offer different layouts within four, six and eight-home rows, while the larger residences form a smaller part of the release.

overview: Equiterra’s brochure pairs a linear park setting with warm, neutral interiors and a shared outdoor recreation programme. Swimming pools, yoga platforms and a padel court sit alongside larger community destinations such as the clubhouse and riding arenas. An amphitheatre and barbecue area add places for informal gatherings. These are proposed community facilities; the opening timetable and any separate membership conditions should be checked before relying on them.
research.locationNote: The community is in south-west Dubai. The brochure places Al Maktoum International Airport, The Oasis and Expo City among nearby reference destinations, with Downtown Dubai farther away. Check the selected home’s access road and actual travel route; brochure journey times are indicative.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s project page states prices from AED 3.5m. The Equiterra fact sheet gives average launch prices of AED 3.6m, AED 4.7m and AED 10.8m for three, four and five bedroom homes. Averages are not entry prices or current offers; request a dated quotation for the particular unit.
research.paymentNote: The original schedule allocates 10% on booking, four further 10% instalments, two 15% stages linked to 60% and 80% construction, then 20% on estimated completion. The payment sheet counts the booking differently from the fact sheet, but their dates and percentages agree. Past instalments require a refreshed purchase schedule.
research.handoverNote: August 2029 is the estimated completion month on the Equiterra payment document and Property Finder. It is not a guarantee of possession; confirm the current programme and contractual terms.

facts.label: Equiterra launch mix
facts.value: 547 homes: 326 three-bedroom, 184 four-bedroom and 37 five-bedroom residences. Category-average plot areas are respectively 1,594, 3,029 and 5,354 sq ft. These are not exact plot measurements for an available home.

facts.label: Townhouse plans
facts.value: Styles B and C are arranged in four, six and eight-home rows. The reviewed Style B three-bedroom drawing places all bedrooms upstairs, with a ground-floor maid’s room, living/dining area, kitchen and terrace. The published total includes suite, garage and balcony/terrace components.

facts.label: Area discrepancies
facts.value: Style B’s 2,171.42 sq ft variant carries differing metric figures and a small component-sum discrepancy on its mirrored drawing. Published square-foot totals are retained; obtain the specific unit’s approved area schedule before purchase.

facts.label: Document scope
facts.value: The linked fifteen-page floor-plan pack covers three and four bedroom townhouses. The five-bedroom figure is a fact-sheet average, not a verified individual layout. The official page’s Equestra download targets have been replaced with Equiterra-labelled copies here.
